scope: Final immutable release candidate SHA freeze for development phase 27-63.

contracts.freeze: After Stage 63 merge, main HEAD is the development-phase release candidate until Gate phase 64+
contracts.noSilentChange: Any post-freeze fix requires new SHA and Gate reset
contracts.gates64to67: Not part of auto-merge development loop

releaseCandidateNote: The Stage 63 merge result SHA becomes the immutable release candidate for Gate phases 64-67; any later code change creates a new candidate and resets all final-gate evidence.
